text:
Elena Gomez: Quick heads-up — we got the Aquila Insurance RFP this morning. They asked for a completed capability matrix, the security questionnaire answers, and a 3-month POC pricing + scope by EOW. I uploaded a draft matrix and the redlined questionnaire for review.

deploy-bot: file uploaded: capability_matrix_aquila_draft.xlsx (shared by Elena Gomez)

Ravi Patel: On it. I'll split the capability matrix rows to show hosted / dedicated / private differences (SLA, isolation, KMS, data residency, throughput). Putting a short comments column with recommended model variants for each use-case.

Samir Shah: For the POC sizing — recommend a baseline 8-GPU pool (NVIDIA A10-ish) with autoscaling to 12 for peak tests. Ballpark infra cost for 3 months ~ $12k/month (engineering estimate) + SE hours. We'll present committed vs burst pricing.

Nora Li: Re: security questionnaire — I'll answer legal/controls sections. Note we should not commit to on-prem deployment timelines in the RFP; we can say "private deployments available with standard enterprise contract and audit review." Also highlight SOC2 + encryption at rest/in transit + KMS support.

Ravi Patel: I'll add a short row for routing & fallbacks so they see our graceful degradation: stream to hosted for cost demo, fallback to dedicated/regional replica on capacity issues. Also adding notes on prefix/KV caching and quantization options that reduce cost.

Samir Shah: POC plan draft below (very short):

```
POC: Aquila Insurance - 90 days
- Week 0-1: onboarding, network & access, sample prompt set
- Week 2-4: baseline perf runs (latency, throughput), integrate prefix cache
- Week 5-8: model variants + quantization experiments, cost tuning
- Week 9-12: resilience tests, canary routing, final handoff
Deliverables: capability matrix, perf report, cost model, rollback playbook
```

Ravi Patel: Also adding an excerpt to the matrix about compliance controls: "audit logs, key rotation, customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, retention policies."

Elena Gomez: @Ravi @Samir @Nora thanks — could each of you drop your final edits by Thurs 2pm PST? I want to bundle everything and send to the buyer contact on Friday morning. Also include a short pricing annex: 3-month POC committed vs flexible burst, and line items for support/SE days.

Samir Shah: Will do. I'll attach the POC runbook after I finish the SLOs.

deploy-bot: file uploaded: aquila_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (shared by Samir Shah)

Nora Li: I'll add redlines to the questionnaire and a legal-safe phrasing for the on-prem / private deployment timeline.

Elena Gomez: Awesome — if anyone sees a blocker (security signoff, legal phrasing, pricing objections) call it out here. Otherwise I'll compile and send. :thumbsup:

Ravi Patel: No blockers from my side. Adding a note about required sample prompts (they need to provide 50 representative prompts + labels for quality checks).

Samir Shah: One small ask — can sales ask them to confirm expected peak RPS and typical response length? that'll change model variant & batch sizing.

Elena Gomez: Good point. I'll include those asks in the email. Thanks everyone.
